metadata.summary: Aksha attempted to order a Hash Brown but was informed it was out of stock and offered alternative side options.

messages.text: Hello Aksha Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
I like to order hatch mail.
I'm sorry, but our Hash Brown is currently out of stock today. Instead, I can offer you our Home Fries, Bacon, or Sausage as a side. Which would you prefer?
